author: StewieFG
body:
Hey guys!
Recently I've been making another map, but on this time by myself. I decided to make it to the contest since it was not meant to be considered as a contest map.
So here we go, here are some details about the map:

Name: Nuxe

Gamemode: Control The Hill

Creators: ElectraXdroid

Images: http://imgur.com/a/Kj1El

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/7a0i08bq1fscer2/Eric4.rar

YAML: http://pastebin.com/D9CzPvNz

Feedback is always appreciated! :D
